## New

- **A new look with depth!** Softer corners, light and shadow, a floating bar. You can switch back in Settings › Look › Depth.
- **Character cards!** Import and export the PNG and JSON cards SillyTavern and Chub use.
- **Lessons (beta)!** Butler learns from your OOC notes so the AI stops repeating mistakes. Turn it on in Settings › Chat, then type /learn.
- **Commands!** Type / in a chat: /note, /retry, /thinking, /length, /agent.
- **Bug fixes!** Lots of things work better now.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.5.0.apk** for your phone: it installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings. **Butler-0.5.0.msi** is for Windows 10 and 11, and installs just for you, no admin needed.
